Docs/Connectors/Notifications

Notifications

Reads your notifications so the assistant can tell you what you missed.

Group
Personal data
Needs
Notification access.
Runs on
Your phone
Privacy
Notifications can be private. They are shared whenever you ask.
Default
Off until you add it in the app

Reads private data from your phone, such as contacts, calendar, location, files and notifications. What you ask about is sent to Gemini.

Tools

Ultron picks the right tool from what you say, so you never have to name one. The phrases are only examples.

  • Read notifications

    read_notifications

    Read the phone's current notifications (sends their text to Gemini).

    Say: Kya kya notifications aaye hain?

  • Reply to a notification

    reply_to_notification

    Reply to a chat notification, for example WhatsApp (sends text).

    Say: Rohan ko bol do main 10 minute mein pahunch raha hu.

  • Dismiss notifications

    dismiss_notification

    Clear notifications from one app or all of them.

    Say: Saari notifications hata do.

  • What is playing

    get_now_playing

    Tell which song or video is playing and in which app.

    Say: Ye kaunsa gaana chal raha hai?
